Definition: Shuthelach, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Shuthelach was the name of two Israelites of Ephraim, the son of Ephraim whose line runs through Bered and Tahath, and the head of the family of the Shuthalhites in the census, whose sons were the Eranites. The same name covers the patriarch and the clan chief.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Ephraim's lines are kept straight in the record. Two men called Shuthelah, father and clan head, and I hold that God knows which is which even when the names repeat.
